stem.en: Binding energy per nucleon peaks around iron and is lower for both very light and very heavy nuclei. What does this explain?
stem.et: Seoseenergia nukleoni kohta saavutab maksimumi raua juures ning on madalam nii väga kergete kui väga raskete tuumade jaoks. Mida see selgitab?
